d: Ahead of the sentencing of Nikhil Gupta, who has pleaded guilty to charges of murder-for-hire conspiracy, murder-for-hire and conspiracy to commit money laundering in connection with the plot to assassinate Sikh separatist and designated terrorist Gurpatwant Singh Pannun, US prosecutors have filed their sentencing submission before a New York court, making several new revelations.
